name: How long does a roof lifespan assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof lifespan assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof lifespan assessment typically varies based on the size and complexity of your roof, but most residential assessments are completed within 1 to 2 hours. Our inspectors meticulously examine all roof components, including shingles, flashing, gutters, and ventilation. We advise homeowners to be present, if possible, to discuss any immediate findings or concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most residential roof lifespan assessments take 1 to 2 hours, depending on roof size and complexity.
